correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the constant-density minimum face disintegration with exact density n(n-1)(1-nt)^(n-2) and independent residual; checked the affine conditional coupling and top-k-sum majorization for each coordinate rank. The covariance follows from an affine conditional expectation, beta variance and H_n identity; a separate normalized-exponential order-statistics calculation yields identical mixed moment. Exact rational code verifies n=2..29 and 71 independent conditional CDF/volume identities, but proof is analytic, not empirical.

originality.rationale: After actual targeted semantic searches of the published result index, accessible historical records, public literature, and inspection of four relevant primary full-text sources, no checked statement was found to give the same simultaneous minimum-conditioned majorization across all Schur-convex functionals. The structural law strictly dominates a single finite min/max moment formula. Classical spacing reviews remain inaccessible and historical priority is unverified; targeted comparisons and explicit residual risk are recorded.
residual_risks: The complete full text of Pyke 1965 and Weiss 1959 was not obtained; a classically known minimum-residual representation or stronger joint spacing theorem might subsume the new coupling.
A numerical finite min/max covariance identity may appear in old tables; only the stronger conditional majorization is advanced as the originality-bearing contribution.
Historical database and literature searches cannot establish uniqueness or priority.

value.rationale: The minimum of a random partition governs guaranteed smallest interval, while majorization governs fragmentation and concentration throughout the same partition. The result couples every conditional law for all thresholds, simultaneously proving dependence signs for every integrable Schur-convex or concave functional, including maximum gap, quadratic concentration and Shannon entropy, a structural statement not confined to one elementary numerical moment. It supplies exact conditional sampling and a finite-n extreme covariance. Uniformity and historical overlap risk are disclosed.
